rationale.conceptual: The model involves a novel coupling of multiple phase transformations (reverse eutectoid, melting, solidification, eutectoid, martensitic) with non‑linear diffusion‑controlled growth equations, pearlite nucleation/growth competition, and temperature‑dependent parameters. Translating this intricate metallurgical framework into correct code demands research‑grade understanding and subtle handling of phase interactions.
rationale.execution: Executing the genuine reproduction requires: (1) preparing a 3D finite‑element mesh and temperature‑dependent properties, (2) implementing a moving laser heat source in a transient FEM solver (e.g., FEniCS), (3) integrating per‑node phase ODEs over the entire temperature history, and (4) post‑processing to extract depth profiles and layer thickness. This multi‑stage pipeline with fragile handoffs justifies a high execution complexity.
